title: OpenAgents Terminal: show what Coder changed (a per-file diff of a run's result)
body:
Top gap 1 and roadmap item 5 of [the Coder Terminal gap analysis](docs/terminal/2026-10-02-coder-terminal-gap-analysis.md#roadmap).

When a Coder run finishes (or while it runs), the terminal shows only a one-line summary ("2 files changed, +39 -1"). Show the actual change: `crates/openagents-chat` (`coder_events`) carries each changed file's patch from the run's worktree, and `crates/coder-terminal`'s run component shows it per file (Ctrl+O on a run result expands it; collapsed by default), using the syntax highlighter from #10149 for the `diff` when it has landed, plain otherwise. Large patches are cut with a line saying how much was left out. The phone and desktop can show the same data later.

Done when a run's result in `openagents terminal` expands to its per-file diff, with tests.
